snippet.title: Assault Course 2 Trailer
snippet.description:
A sequel to the popular Assault Course pits you once more against the challenges of the army assault course. Do you have the strength and agility to take on the course?

📱 Miniclip has plenty of FREE games for you! Play now: https://mcgam.es/PlayMiniclip

ABOUT MINICLIP 

Miniclip is a global leader in digital games and one of the world's biggest developers and publishers of mobile games. Over the years, we develop, publish and distribute high-quality games to an audience of 400 million monthly passionate players worldwide.

Legacy and leading franchises include 8 Ball Pool™, Agar.io™, Club Penguin™,  Subway Surfers™, Rail Rush™, Strawberry Shortcake™, Head Ball 2™, Triple Match 3D™ and plenty more! In 2021, we achieved a Guinness World Records title for the Most Downloaded Mobile Pool Game. In 2024, Miniclip reached 10 billion downloads.

Our YouTube channel brings you the best trailers, walkthroughs, tips and tricks and gameplay footage from all your favourite Miniclip games! Subscribe now: https://mcgam.es/miniclipsubscribe
